images.prompt: Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of a narrative adventure titled "마지막 이삿날". Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Camera: straight-on side view of a worn apartment corridor on the third floor of a building slated for demolition, like a stage set; three brown wooden doors labelled 301, 302, 303, stained two-tone concrete walls, buzzing fluorescent tubes casting cones of light, a sunset window at the far right showing construction cranes, a red spray-painted 철거 mark, stacked moving boxes and a half-dragged wardrobe. Core mechanic visible: a silhouetted young person crouched with an ear to door 302 while soft amber sound waves seep from the gap under the door, and a speech-like caption box above describing a voice calling for a lost cat. Top right: an 8-hour clock bar with three used hours and two hours previewed in dashed amber. Bottom: four action cards with time costs, the last one tinted as the final truck decision. Palette: teal-grey concrete, sodium amber, rust red. Melancholic warmth, film grain. Korean UI: "마지막 이삿날", "오후 2:00", "계단 아래 고양이 찾기 · 2시간".

Polished landscape 16:9 gameplay screenshot of the ending of a narrative adventure titled "마지막 이삿날". Actual gameplay view, not poster, no device frame. Camera: street-level wide shot at dusk of an old four-storey apartment facade with dark boarded windows marked with red X, only the third-floor open corridor glowing warm amber where neighbors carry boxes together; below, a small white moving truck with an open lit cargo box and an elderly woman silhouetted in the cab, its headlight beam cutting across the dark street; neighbors carry the last boxes and a cat carrier. Background: purple-to-orange dusk sky, new high-rise silhouettes and a tower crane with a blinking red light. Left: large serif title and short narration, three small stat tiles, and a slightly rotated paper memo listing how the day's hours were spent with names crossed off. Palette: dusk violet, sodium amber, concrete grey, rust red. Bittersweet communal warmth. Korean UI: "함께 떠나는 복도", "도운 이웃 3", "303호".
